### 8. USL in use: how many Wikipedia infobox figures are, and aren't, INE's Census 2024 count

```sql
SELECT c.source_name, count(*) AS infobox_figures,
       sum(CASE WHEN c.value = f.population THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS census_2024_count,
       sum(CASE WHEN c.value IS NULL OR c.value <> f.population THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS something_else
FROM lightning.metastore.factsync.comuna_population.population_claim c
JOIN lightning.metastore.factsync.comuna_population.official_figure f
  ON f.cut = c.cut AND f.series = 'official_census' AND f.reference_year = 2024
WHERE c.source_name IN ('Wikipedia ES', 'Wikipedia EN')
GROUP BY c.source_name
```

| source_name | infobox_figures | census_2024_count | something_else |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wikipedia EN | 280 | 27 | 253 |
| Wikipedia ES | 281 | 32 | 249 |

_2 row(s) shown; 89480 ms._

### 9. USL in use: what each infobox figure equals among INE's official figures (the "why" in one join)

```sql
SELECT c.source_name,
       CASE WHEN f.series IS NULL THEN 'no official figure'
            WHEN f.series = 'official_projections' THEN 'an INE projection'
            ELSE concat(f.source_name, ' count') END AS equals,
       count(*) AS infobox_figures
FROM lightning.metastore.factsync.comuna_population.population_claim c
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.factsync.comuna_population.official_figure f
  ON f.cut = c.cut AND f.population = c.value AND f.scope = 'comuna'
WHERE c.source_name IN ('Wikipedia ES', 'Wikipedia EN')
GROUP BY c.source_name,
       CASE WHEN f.series IS NULL THEN 'no official figure'
            WHEN f.series = 'official_projections' THEN 'an INE projection'
            ELSE concat(f.source_name, ' count') END
ORDER BY c.source_name, infobox_figures DESC
```

| source_name | equals | infobox_figures |
|---|---|---|
| Wikipedia EN | no official figure | 197 |
| Wikipedia EN | INE Censo 2002 count | 33 |
| Wikipedia EN | INE Censo 2024 count | 27 |
| Wikipedia EN | INE Censo 2017 count | 23 |
| Wikipedia EN | an INE projection | 8 |
| Wikipedia ES | INE Censo 2017 count | 200 |
| Wikipedia ES | no official figure | 42 |
| Wikipedia ES | INE Censo 2024 count | 32 |
| Wikipedia ES | an INE projection | 25 |
| Wikipedia ES | INE Censo 2002 count | 2 |


| name | table | type | expression |
|---|---|---|---|
| cut | comuna | Primary key constraints |  |
| cut_is_code | comuna | Custom Data Quality | cut RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}$' |
| figure_id | official_figure | Primary key constraints |  |
| cut | official_figure | Foreign key constraints |  |
| population_positive | official_figure | Custom Data Quality | population > 0 OR (scope IN ('urban', 'rural') AND population = 0) |
| claim_id | population_claim | Primary key constraints |  |
| cut | population_claim | Foreign key constraints |  |
| figure_is_a_number | population_claim | Custom Data Quality | value IS NOT NULL |
